item.description:

Cheesecake Factory’s absolutely unhinged design is part of the marketing.

Every location is customized, which means no two restaurants look exactly the same.

And people definitely notice.

The aesthetic has been compared to everything from “Eye of Sauron” to “’90s Tuscan wine mom.”

But that’s part of the point.

Cheesecake Factory wants the entire experience, from the food to the lighting and design, to be memorable enough that you go tell someone about it.

item.title: ✖️ The Hustle This machine can kill up to 10,000 weeds a minute. With lasers. Th
item.description:
✖️ The Hustle

This machine can kill up to 10,000 weeds a minute. With lasers.

That's the idea behind @carbon_robotics' LaserWeeder.

As it rolls through a field, cameras capture every plant underneath it, and an AI decides what's a crop and what's a weed.

Then a laser burns out the weed's meristem, the growth center that produces its new leaves, stems and roots. As long as those cells survive, the weed keeps growing.

Hitting that spot takes sub-millimeter precision.

The target is tiny, the machine never stops moving, and one wrong shot could kill a crop just centimeters away. So 24 NVIDIA GPUs track every weed and correct each shot in real time.

The whole process, from the first image to the laser hitting the meristem, has to happen in about 100 milliseconds.

Killing weeds with a laser, it turns out, is mostly a problem of aim.
